description: This file is a C++ source code implementation for the CosaMTA class, providing methods to interact with the MTA (Multi-Tenant Access) features. It includes functions for initializing the module, retrieving reset counts, DHCP info, battery status, service flow, logs, and various configuration states, as well as setting parameters like Dect PIN, registration modes, and logs. The code makes extensive use of external wrapper functions (ssp_*), JSON for input/output, and handles internal and external state interactions.
